// Adventurer Guide (pre-renewal): tells each class which monsters to hunt at its level, where to farm
// gear and cards, and which stats and skills to take. Generated by tools/build.js from tools/data.js.
//
// The class is read from eaclass(): base job (EAJ_*), 2nd-class line (EAJL_2_1 / EAJL_2_2).
// Rebirth and baby classes use the page of their base line. The player can also open any other
// class's page. No character variables are written.

prontera,136,171,4	script	Adventurer Guide#advguidepre	4_M_CRU_OLD,{
	.@eac = eaclass();
	.@line = 0; .@br = 0; .@known = 1;
	if (.@eac < 0) {
		.@known = 0;
	} else {
		.@line = .@eac & EAJ_BASEMASK;
		if (.@line > 9) { .@line = 0; .@known = 0; }
		if (.@eac & EAJL_2_1) .@br = 1;
		else if (.@eac & EAJL_2_2) .@br = 2;
		if (.@eac & EAJL_UPPER) .@upper = 1;
	}
	setarray .@maxbr[0], 1, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 1, 2;
	if (.@br > .@maxbr[.@line]) .@br = .@maxbr[.@line];

	setarray .@bn$[0], "Novice", "Super Novice", "", "Swordman", "Knight line", "Crusader line", "Mage", "Wizard line", "Sage line", "Archer", "Hunter line", "Bard / Dancer line", "Acolyte", "Priest line", "Monk line", "Merchant", "Blacksmith line", "Alchemist line", "Thief", "Assassin line", "Rogue line", "Taekwon", "Star Gladiator line", "Soul Linker line", "Gunslinger", "Rebellion line", "", "Ninja", "Kagerou line", "Oboro line";
	setarray .@cn$[0], "Novice", "Swordman", "Mage", "Archer", "Acolyte", "Merchant", "Thief", "Taekwon", "Gunslinger", "Ninja";
	setarray .@lo[0], 1, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 70, 80, 90;
	.@nb = 10;

	.@bracket = 0;
	for (.@i = 0; .@i < .@nb; .@i++) { if (BaseLevel >= .@lo[.@i]) .@bracket = .@i; }


L_Menu:
	mes "[Adventurer Guide]";
	mes "Hello, " + strcharinfo(0) + ". I have walked every dungeon in Rune-Midgarts.";
	mes "You are a ^0000FF" + jobname(Class) + "^000000, base level ^0000FF" + BaseLevel + "^000000.";
	if (.@known == 0) mes "I do not have a page for your class yet. Showing the Novice guide; pick another class below.";
	mes "Guide shown for: ^0000FF" + .@bn$[.@line * 3 + .@br] + "^000000.";
	next;
	switch (select("Where should I level now?:Level spots for another level range:Gear and cards:Stats and skills:Bosses (MVP) I can try:Server rates:Show another class:How to look things up:Goodbye")) {
	case 1:
		callsub L_Spots, .@bracket, .@line * 10 + .@br;
		next;
		goto L_Menu;
	case 2:
		mes "[Adventurer Guide]";
		mes "Which level range?";
		.@m$ = "";
		for (.@i = 0; .@i < .@nb; .@i++) {
			.@hi = (.@i + 1 < .@nb ? .@lo[.@i + 1] - 1 : 0);
			.@m$ += "Level " + .@lo[.@i] + (.@hi ? "-" + .@hi : "+") + (.@i == .@bracket ? " (you)" : "") + ":";
		}
		.@pick = select(.@m$ + "Back") - 1;
		if (.@pick >= .@nb) goto L_Menu;
		callsub L_Spots, .@pick, .@line * 10 + .@br;
		next;
		goto L_Menu;
	case 3:
		mes "[Adventurer Guide]";
		mes "What do you need?";
		.@g = select("Buy from NPCs (starter and shop gear):Weapon cards:Weapons only monsters drop:Armor and shield cards:Garment, shoes, accessory cards:Headgear cards:Armor and accessories only monsters drop:Cards worth collecting:Tips on finding gear:Back");
		if (.@g == 10) goto L_Menu;
		if (.@g == 1) callsub L_Starter, .@line * 10 + .@br;
		else if (.@g == 8) {
			mes "[Adventurer Guide]";
			mes "Which kind of card?";
			.@cg = select("Always useful:Damage taken from a race (shield):Damage dealt to a race (weapon):Damage dealt to an element (weapon):Damage dealt to a size (weapon):Change your element (armor):Elemental resist (garment):Status immunity (headgear):Back") - 1;
			if (.@cg >= 8) goto L_Menu;
			callsub L_Cards, .@cg;
		}
		else if (.@g == 9) {
			mes "[Adventurer Guide]";
			mes "Tip: ^0000FF@whodrops <item>^000000 and ^0000FF@mi <monster>^000000 show";
			mes "who drops what, and where. Cards drop at";
			mes "about 0.01%, so a farm spot with many";
			mes "monsters on one screen is better than a rare";
			mes "one.";
		}
		else callsub L_GearSec, (.@line * 10 + .@br) * 10 + .@g;
		next;
		goto L_Menu;
	case 4:
		.@vn$ = callsub(L_BuildNames, .@line * 10 + .@br);
		.@v = 0;
		if (.@vn$ != "") {
			mes "[Adventurer Guide]";
			mes "Which playstyle?";
			.@v = select(.@vn$) - 1;
		}
		callsub L_Build, .@line * 10 + .@br, .@v;
		next;
		callsub L_EraNote;
		if (.@upper && .@br > 0) callsub L_Trans, .@line * 10 + .@br;
		next;
		goto L_Menu;
	case 5:
		setarray .@mlo[0], 60, 70, 80, 90;
		setarray .@mnames$[0], "MVPs level 60-69", "MVPs level 70-79", "MVPs level 80-89", "MVPs level 90+";
		.@mrec = -1;
		for (.@i = 0; .@i < 4; .@i++) { if (BaseLevel + 5 >= .@mlo[.@i]) .@mrec = .@i; }
		mes "[Adventurer Guide]";
		mes "These are only rough pointers from element";
		mes "weakness, DEF / MDEF, HP and the skills each";
		mes "boss uses. Even a boss that could be";
		mes "possible needs good gear, potions and a Fly";
		mes "Wing.";
		if (.@mrec < 0) mes "The lowest boss listed is around level " + .@mlo[0] + ", so you are still early.";
		mes "Which boss level range?";
		.@m$ = "";
		for (.@i = 0; .@i < 4; .@i++) .@m$ += .@mnames$[.@i] + (.@i == .@mrec ? " (closest to your level)" : "") + ":";
		.@mp = select(.@m$ + "Back") - 1;
		if (.@mp >= 4) goto L_Menu;
		callsub L_Mvp, .@mp, .@line * 10 + .@br;
		next;
		goto L_Menu;
	case 6:
		callsub L_Rates;
		next;
		goto L_Menu;
	case 7:
		mes "[Adventurer Guide]";
		mes "Which class do you want to read about?";
		.@m$ = "";
		for (.@i = 0; .@i < 10; .@i++) .@m$ += .@cn$[.@i] + ":";
		.@c = select(.@m$ + "Back") - 1;
		if (.@c >= 10) goto L_Menu;
		.@line = .@c;
		.@br = 0;
		if (.@maxbr[.@line] > 0) {
			mes "[Adventurer Guide]";
			mes "Which branch?";
			.@m$ = "";
			for (.@i = 0; .@i <= .@maxbr[.@line]; .@i++) .@m$ += .@bn$[.@line * 3 + .@i] + ":";
			.@br = select(.@m$) - 1;
		}
		goto L_Menu;
	case 8:
		mes "[Adventurer Guide]";
		mes "^0000FF@mi <monster>^000000 shows a monster's level, HP, element and drops.";
		mes "^0000FF@whodrops <item>^000000 lists who drops an item.";
		mes "^0000FF@ii <item>^000000 shows an item's stats and effect.";
		mes "Check the monster's element before you cast or enchant.";
		mes "If a spot is too hard, go back one level range. If it is too easy, go forward.";
		next;
		goto L_Menu;
	case 9:
		mes "[Adventurer Guide]";
		mes "Good hunting!";
		close;
	}
	end;

L_Spots:

L_Mvp:
	.@k = getarg(1);
	.@p = 7;
	if (.@k == 12) .@p = 2;
	if (.@k == 20 || .@k == 21 || .@k == 22 || .@k == 90 || .@k == 91 || .@k == 92) .@p = 0;
	if (.@k == 30 || .@k == 32 || .@k == 80 || .@k == 81) .@p = 4;
	if (.@k == 31) .@p = 3;
	if (.@k == 40 || .@k == 41) .@p = 1;
	if (.@k == 42) .@p = 6;
	if (.@k == 60 || .@k == 61 || .@k == 62) .@p = 5;
	switch (getarg(0)) {
	case 0:
		mes "[Adventurer Guide]";
		mes "^0000FFGolden Thief Bug^000000 lv64, Fire 2, Insect,";
		mes "Large, HP 126k. Prontera Culvert F4. Card:";
		mes "Golden Thief Bug Card.";
		if (BaseLevel + 10 < 64) mes "Far above your level for now.";
		else if (BaseLevel + 3 < 64) mes "A bit above your level.";
		if (.@p == 0) {
			mes "For your class: Possible only with good";
			mes "preparation: weak to Water: Cold Bolt /";
			mes "Storm Gust. Skills to watch are on the next";
			mes "page.";
		}
		if (.@p == 1 || .@p == 2 || .@p == 4 || .@p == 5 || .@p == 7) {
			mes "For your class: Unlikely alone. Skills to";
			mes "watch are on the next page.";
		}
		if (.@p == 3) {
			mes "For your class: Possible only with good";
			mes "preparation: traps ignore its DEF. Skills to";
			mes "watch are on the next page.";
		}
		if (.@p == 6) {
			mes "For your class: Possible only with good";
			mes "preparation: Investigate scales with its";
			mes "DEF; Asura Strike can end it fast. Skills to";
			mes "watch are on the next page.";
		}
		next;
		mes "[Adventurer Guide]";
		mes "^0000FFGolden Thief Bug^000000 - skills to watch:";
		mes "^0000FFShield Reflect^000000: sends melee damage back at";
		mes "you. Use ranged attacks.";
		mes "^0000FFAssumptio^000000: halves the damage it takes for a";
		mes "while.";
		mes "^0000FFMagnum Break^000000: fire AoE with knockback.";
		mes "^0000FFMinions^000000: summons and recalls minions. Kill";
		mes "or AoE them first, or they swarm you.";
		next;
		mes "[Adventurer Guide]";
		mes "^0000FFTeleport^000000: it can teleport away when hit.";
		mes "Burst it down or trap it.";
		mes "^0000FFGuided Attack^000000: never misses, so Flee will";
		mes "not help.";
		next;
		mes "[Adventurer Guide]";
		mes "^0000FFEddga^000000 lv65, Fire 1, Brute, Large, HP 152k.";
		mes "Payon field. Card: Eddga Card.";
		if (BaseLevel + 10 < 65) mes "Far above your level for now.";
		else if (BaseLevel + 3 < 65) mes "A bit above your level.";
		if (.@p == 0) {
			mes "For your class: Possible only with good";
			mes "preparation: weak to Water: Cold Bolt /";
			mes "Storm Gust. Skills to watch are on the next";
			mes "page.";
		}
		if (.@p == 1 || .@p == 2 || .@p == 4 || .@p == 5 || .@p == 7) {
			mes "For your class: Possible only with good";
			mes "preparation. Skills to watch are on the next";
			mes "page.";
		}
		if (.@p == 3) {
			mes "For your class: Unlikely alone: Claymore";
			mes "Trap / Land Mine. Skills to watch are on the";
			mes "next page.";
		}
		if (.@p == 6) {
			mes "For your class: Possible only with good";
			mes "preparation: Asura Strike can end it fast.";
			mes "Skills to watch are on the next page.";
		}
		next;
		mes "[Adventurer Guide]";
		mes "^0000FFEddga^000000 - skills to watch:";
		mes "^0000FFMinions^000000: summons and recalls minions. Kill";
		mes "or AoE them first, or they swarm you.";
		mes "^0000FFMagnum Break^000000: fire AoE with knockback.";
		mes "^0000FFStatus attacks^000000: bleeding. Helpful: Ungoliant";
		mes "Card.";
		mes "^0000FFTeleport^000000: it can teleport away when hit.";
		mes "Burst it down or trap it.";
		mes "^0000FFPower Up^000000: hits harder when it is hurt.";
		next;
		mes "[Adventurer Guide]";
		mes "^0000FFHeal^000000: heals itself. Burst it.";
		next;
		mes "[Adventurer Guide]";
		mes "^0000FFMoonlight Flower^000000 lv67, Fire 3, Demon,";
		mes "Medium, HP 120k. Payon Cave F5. Card:";
		mes "Moonlight Flower Card.";
		if (BaseLevel + 10 < 67) mes "Far above your level for now.";
		else if (BaseLevel + 3 < 67) mes "A bit above your level.";
		if (.@p == 0) {
			mes "For your class: Possible only with good";
			mes "preparation: weak to Water: Cold Bolt /";
			mes "Storm Gust. Skills to watch are on the next";
			mes "page.";
		}
		if (.@p == 1 || .@p == 2) {
			mes "For your class: Possible only with good";
			mes "preparation: Demon: Magnus Exorcismus works.";

L_Rates:
	mes "[Adventurer Guide]";
	mes "^0000FFExperience rates^000000 (1 = normal)";
	.@r0 = getbattleflag("base_exp_rate");
	mes "Base EXP: x" + (.@r0 / 100) + (.@r0 % 100 ? "." + (.@r0 % 100 < 10 ? "0" : "") + (.@r0 % 100) : "");
	.@r1 = getbattleflag("job_exp_rate");
	mes "Job EXP: x" + (.@r1 / 100) + (.@r1 % 100 ? "." + (.@r1 % 100 < 10 ? "0" : "") + (.@r1 % 100) : "");
	.@r2 = getbattleflag("mvp_exp_rate");
	mes "MVP EXP: x" + (.@r2 / 100) + (.@r2 % 100 ? "." + (.@r2 % 100 < 10 ? "0" : "") + (.@r2 % 100) : "");
	.@r3 = getbattleflag("quest_exp_rate");
	mes "Quest EXP: x" + (.@r3 / 100) + (.@r3 % 100 ? "." + (.@r3 % 100 < 10 ? "0" : "") + (.@r3 % 100) : "");
	next;
	mes "[Adventurer Guide]";
	mes "^0000FFDrop rates^000000 (1 = normal)";
	.@d0 = getbattleflag("item_rate_common");
	mes "Normal items: x" + (.@d0 / 100) + (.@d0 % 100 ? "." + (.@d0 % 100 < 10 ? "0" : "") + (.@d0 % 100) : "");
	.@d1 = getbattleflag("item_rate_heal");
	mes "Healing items: x" + (.@d1 / 100) + (.@d1 % 100 ? "." + (.@d1 % 100 < 10 ? "0" : "") + (.@d1 % 100) : "");
	.@d2 = getbattleflag("item_rate_use");
	mes "Usable items: x" + (.@d2 / 100) + (.@d2 % 100 ? "." + (.@d2 % 100 < 10 ? "0" : "") + (.@d2 % 100) : "");
	.@d3 = getbattleflag("item_rate_equip");
	mes "Equipment: x" + (.@d3 / 100) + (.@d3 % 100 ? "." + (.@d3 % 100 < 10 ? "0" : "") + (.@d3 % 100) : "");
	.@d4 = getbattleflag("item_rate_card");
	mes "Cards: x" + (.@d4 / 100) + (.@d4 % 100 ? "." + (.@d4 % 100 < 10 ? "0" : "") + (.@d4 % 100) : "");
	.@d5 = getbattleflag("item_rate_mvp");
	mes "MVP rewards: x" + (.@d5 / 100) + (.@d5 % 100 ? "." + (.@d5 % 100 < 10 ? "0" : "") + (.@d5 % 100) : "");
	.@bc = getbattleflag("item_rate_card_boss");
	mes "Cards from bosses: x" + (.@bc / 100) + (.@bc % 100 ? "." + (.@bc % 100 < 10 ? "0" : "") + (.@bc % 100) : "");
	next;
	mes "[Adventurer Guide]";
	mes "^0000FFWhat that means for cards^000000";
	mes "A normal card has a base chance of 0.01% (1 in 10,000 kills).";
	.@n = (.@d4 > 0 ? 1000000 / .@d4 : 0);
	if (.@n > 0) mes "With your card rate that is about 1 in " + .@n + " kills.";
	else mes "Cards do not drop on this server.";
	mes "The drop chances on the gear pages are the normal rates; multiply them by the drop rate above.";
	return;

L_Build:
	switch (getarg(0)) {
	case 0:
		switch (getarg(1)) {

		return "Kick combo (Running):Counter Kick (Tumbling / Flee)";
	case 80:
		return "Revolver (Rapid Shower / Desperado):Rifle (Tracking / Piercing Shot):Gatling (Gatling Fever):Shotgun (Dust / Full Buster / Spread Attack)";
	case 81:
		return "Rifle (Hammer of God):Shotgun (Banishing Buster / Shatter Storm):Gatling / Revolver crowds";
	case 90:
		return "Elemental caster (spells):Shuriken thrower (physical)";
	case 91:
		return "Kagerou (kunai and combos):Illusion and boss control";
	case 92:
		return "Oboro (moon skills):Charm caster";
	}
	return "";

L_EraNote:
	mes "[Adventurer Guide]";
	mes "^0000FFPre-renewal rules^000000: base level tops out at 99";
	mes "and every stat caps at 99. There are no";
	mes "third classes, so the 2nd-class pages are";
	mes "your endgame. Stats count the classic way:";
	mes "Flee, HIT, Critical and plain ATK.";
	return;

	end;
